reviewAdvisory: The draft treats the 625 yuan cut as if it were the full ceiling price per tonne, but the figures give only the size of the cut, not the prior or new ceiling level, so the per-tonne reduction cannot be derived from the supplied figures.
The confidence section first says every figure comes from the single NDRC notice and then immediately attributes two figures to China Daily, contradicting itself and misstating the sourcing.

The 1.25 percent policy rate and 1.327 percent DR001 figure are single-sourced to China Daily but the article does not carry a clear single-source disclosure for them in the body, only a buried note in the confidence section.

The figure record gives the 1.25 percent rate as applying to each working day since November 2, 2026, but the draft presents it as a current policy rate without the period qualifier, and the DR001 figure is described as 'Wednesday' without anchoring it to the stated week.
